Item2.description:
Please note: This is a participation opportunity for learning and development, not a volunteering opportunity. No community service is involved, and service hours will not be awarded.


Project Re:ground is an initiative by Youth Corps Singapore, in collaboration with the Health Promotion Board, to advocate for the importance of youth mental well-being and peer support as a life skill.


Re:ground @ Dungeon is a space for youths to step away from the bustle of their daily routines; to pause, recharge, and explore self-care activities that support their mental well-being.


Join us for Regular Nights, where you can unwind at your own pace - whether that means connecting with others, chatting with a Peer Supporter, trying something hands-on, or simply enjoying some quiet time alone. From activities like colouring, reading, puzzles and more, come discover what works for you.


Check out our featured activities for the month:


Clay

  • Give your mind a break by moulding air dry clay to your vision! Clay tools will be provided, and you'll get to bring your unique artwork home!


Bricks

  • Unwind and get creative by building your own nano brick cartoon character to bring home, or let your imagination run free with our Lego bricks! (Do note that lego bricks cannot be brought home.)


Watercolours

  • Take some time to slow down, relax and express yourself with our watercolour materials! Create your own peaceful piece of artwork and bring it home with you.


Conversation cards

  • Connect with others through meaningful conversations using different conversation cards (such as We’re Not Really Strangers) available at the Dungeon! Pick a deck, grab a friend and see where the conversation takes you.


We also host monthly Themed Nights, featuring specially curated activities centred around different themes.


Do note that this registration is for Regular Nights only and is for participation rather than volunteering. Details for Themed Nights will be shared through separate DCA opportunities.
Item2.label: Re:ground @ Dungeon - Oct 2026

Item2.description:
Project Re:ground is an initiative by Youth Corps Singapore, in collaboration with the Health Promotion Board to advocate the importance of youth mental well-being and peer support as a life skill.


Re:ground @ Dungeon is a space where youths can come by and seek respite from the bustle of their daily routine by participating in self-care activities that support their mental well-being. These sessions are participation opportunities, with participation hours awarded for attending.


Come for our themed nights to practice self-care through activities based on a specific theme!


Make time for yourself this World Mental Health Day with The Scrapbook Club!


In line with World Mental Health Day and this year’s Beyond the Label theme, “Mental Wellness Begins With All Of Us,” take some time to slow down, unwind and reflect on the people, experiences and moments that bring you joy.


Start your mental wellness journey with us through scrapbooking; a simple way to pause, reflect and appreciate the people and experiences that support our well-being.


Through photos, drawings and words, create your own scrapbook celebrating cherished relationships, memorable adventures or personal achievements. Enjoy an evening of creativity and reflection, and take home a keepsake that is uniquely yours. No artistic experience needed!


This is an event opportunity that aims to raise social awareness for your learning and development. No community service is involved; hence hours awarded are participation hours, rather than volunteering or community service hours.
